en_how: Two original toon-shaded fighters built from boxes and capsules on a joint hierarchy are posed by keyframes (a shared keyAt helper) with an anticipation, strike and recovery for each move; every hit freezes time for a few frames (hit-stop), shakes the camera and throws a burst of particles and a white flash; MeshToon gradients plus back-face outlines give the cel look, the camera cuts between shots, and the fight moves from a desert to a temple.
